About the studio

Design, made in a real workspace.

LUMI Graphic Studios is a freelance design practice built around close, hands-on collaboration — no account managers, no hand-offs, just direct work between you and the person designing. Every brand, layout, and campaign asset is sketched, refined, and finished right here.
